en: An old Russian Imperial postal card with pre-printed Cyrillic text. At the top it reads 'ПОЧТОВАЯ КАРТОЧКА' (Postcard). The left upper corner bears the double-headed imperial eagle emblem. On the right is a boxed area for a stamp with printed text, and circular black postal cancellation marks showing a date (likely 11.6.16). The rest of the card is filled with handwritten address information in cursive Cyrillic, and there is a printed line of instructions at the bottom indicating that only the address is to be written on this side. At the lower right, small print includes the word 'Киевск.' indicating production in the Kiev postal district.
